page.overview:
Who is Tritoma?

Tritoma is a former empress of the Kuja tribe, succeeding Shakuyaku and preceding Boa Hancock. She died years ago, as a victim of Love Sickness.

Like the other known empresses of the Kuja, Tritoma was a young-looking woman of slim stature. She had shoulder-length straight dark hair (curly at the ends), lipstick, and wore a similar outfit to what her successor, Hancock, currently does, including a V-neck blouse and snake-shaped hoop earrings.

44 years ago, she appeared younger, with shorter hair and no lipstick. She wore a long cape, a leopard-print short top and skirt, simple pearl earrings, and sandals.

She was described by Boa Hancock as benevolent as she pardoned former Empress Gloriosa for the crime of abandoning the nation.
